script:

test "$(cat /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-rps100-20261120/results/setup/b12x-install-exit.txt)" = 0
aws s3 cp s3://karpo-benchmark-20261119-115003-632930644527/inputs/vllm-rps-b12x-v1.tar.gz /tmp/vllm-rps-b12x-v1.tar.gz --region us-east-1 --no-progress

systemd-run --unit=karpo-rps-single-b12x-v1 --property=RuntimeMaxSec=5400 --property=StandardOutput=append:/opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-rps100-20261120/results/setup/b12x-launch.log --property=StandardError=inherit --setenv=PYTHONPATH=/opt/karpo/b12x-overlay /opt/karpo/venv-vllm034/bin/python -u /opt/karpo/scripts/vllm_rps_b12x_suite.py --name single-b12x-v1 --revision b12x-v1 --gpus 1 --replicas 1 --batches 1 2 4 8 --seconds 20
